question:
A sector is cut out from a circle of diameter 42 cm. If the angle of the sector is 150°, then its area (in cm2) is: (Take π = 22/7) 
(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 577.5.

Area of circle = π⁣R² 
⇒ \(\frac{22}{7}\) × 21 × 21 = 22 × 3 × 21 
360° → 22 × 3 × 21 
150° → \(\frac{22 × 3 × 21}{360°} \) × 150° 
⇒ \(\frac{2310}{4}\) = 577.5 cm²

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 577.5 है।

question:
A race track is in the shape of a ring whose inner and outer circumferences are 440 m and 506 m, respectively. What is the cost of leveling the track at ₹6/m²? (Take π = 22/7) 
(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution:

Cost = 6 ×  \(\frac{22}{7} × \frac{301}{2} × \frac{21}{2}\) = ₹29,799

question:
The area of a circular path enclosed by two concentric circles is 3080 m². If the difference between the radius of the outer edge and that of the inner edge of the circular path is 10 m, what is the sum (in m) of the two radii? (Take π = 22/7 ) 
(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 98.

Area of a circular path enclosed by two concentric circles = π (R² - r²)
⇒ π(R² - r²) = 3080 
⇒ \(\frac{22}{7}\) (R + r) (R - r) = 3080 
⇒ \(\frac{22}{7}\)(R + r) × 10 = 3080 
⇒ R + r = 98 m

question:
The inner circumference of a circular path enclosed between two concentric circles is 264 m. The uniform width of the circular path is 3 m. What is the area (in m², to the nearest whole number) of the path? (Take π = 22/7 ) 
(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 820.

⇒ 2πr = 264 
⇒ r = \( \frac{264}{2} \) × \(\frac{7}{22} \) = 42
⇒ R = 42 + 3 = 45
Area of the path = πR2 – πr² = π(R² - r)  
⇒ π(R + r)(R - r) = \(\frac{22}{7}\) × 87 × 3 = 820.28 ≈ 820 m²
question_hi:

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:

⇒ 2πr = 264 
⇒ r = \( \frac{264}{2} \) × \(\frac{7}{22} \) = 42
⇒ R = 42 + 3 = 45
पथ का क्षेत्रफल = πR2 – πr² = π(R² - r) 
⇒ π(R + r)(R - r) = \(\frac{22}{7}\) × 87 × 3 = 820.28 ≈ 820 मी²

question:
The ratio of the outer and the inner circumference of a circular path is 5 : 4. If the path is 50 metres wide, then what is the radius of the inner circle? 
(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 200 mtr.

Let the radius of the inner circle = r
Radius of outer circle = R 
According to the question,
⇒ \( \frac{2\pi R}{2\pi r}\) = \( \frac{5}{4} \)
⇒ \(\frac{R}{r} = \frac{5}{4} \)
⇒ \( \frac{r\ +\ 50}{r} = \frac{5}{4}\)
⇒ 4r + 200 = 5r 
⇒ r = 200 m
question_hi:
एक वृत्ताकार पथ की बाहरी और आंतरिक परिधि का अनुपात 5: 4 है। यदि पथ 50 मीटर चौड़ा है, तो आंतरिक वृत्त की त्रिज्या क्या है?
(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 200 मी है। 

मान लीजिए आंतरिक वृत्त की त्रिज्‍या = r
बाहरी वृत्त की त्रिज्‍या = R 
प्रश्ननुसार,
⇒ \( \frac{2\pi R}{2\pi r}\) = \( \frac{5}{4} \)
⇒ \(\frac{R}{r} = \frac{5}{4} \)
⇒ \( \frac{r\ +\ 50}{r} = \frac{5}{4}\)
⇒ 4r + 200 = 5r 
⇒ r = 200 मी

question:

question:
What is the difference in area (in cm2) of ABC having sides of 10 cm, 20 cm, and 20 cm, and a right-angled triangle \(\triangle\)PQR with hypotenuse of 13 cm and one of the perpendiculars of 12 cm? 
Note: \(\sqrt2 = 1.41, \sqrt3 = 1.73, \sqrt7 = 2.65, \sqrt{13} = 3.61, \sqrt{15} = 3.87, \sqrt{27} = 4.58.\)
{CGL 2024Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 66.75.

Height (AD) = \(\sqrt{20^2 - 5^2 }\) = \( \sqrt{25\ \times\ 15} = 5\sqrt{15} cm\)

Area of right angle \(\triangle\)= \(\frac{1}{2}\) × 5 × 12 = 30 cm2
\(\therefore\) Difference in area = \(25\sqrt{15}\) - 30 = 25 × 3.87 - 30 = 96.75 - 30 = 66.75 cm2

question:
The force (in pound-force) needed to keep a car from skidding on a curve varies directly with the weight of the car (in pounds) and the square of its speed (in miles per hour [mph]) and inversely with the radius (in feet) of the curve. Suppose 6125 poundforce is required to keep a 2750-pound car, travelling at a speed of 35 mph, from skidding on a curve of radius 550 feet. How much pound-force is then required to keep a 3600-pound car, travelling at a speed of 50 mph, from skidding on a curve of radius 750 feet? 
(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 12000.

Force \(\alpha\) weight of car × (speed)2 
Force \(\alpha\)\(\ \frac{1}{radius}\)
Force⁣⁣ \(\alpha\)\( \frac{weight\ of\ car\ \times\ {(Speed)}^2}{radius} \)
⇒ 6125 = \(K. \frac{2750\ \times\ 35\ \times\ 35}{550}\)
⇒ 5 = \(K. \frac{2750}{550} \)
\(\therefore\) K = 1 
Force required = \(\frac{1\ \times\ 3600\ \times\ 50\ \times\ 50}{750} \) = 12000

(CGL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 12000 है। 

बल \(\alpha\) कार का वजन × (गति)2 
बल \(\alpha\) 1/त्रिज्या
बल⁣⁣ \(\alpha\) कार का वजन × (गति)2/त्रिज्या
⇒ 6125 = \(K. \frac{2750\ \times\ 35\ \times\ 35}{550}\)
⇒ 5 = \(K. \frac{2750}{550} \)
\(\therefore\) K = 1 
आवश्‍यक बल = \(\frac{1\ \times\ 3600\ \times\ 50\ \times\ 50}{750} \) = 12000

question:
The radius of a roller is 14 cm and its length is 20 cm. It takes 235 complete revolutions to move once over to level a playground. Find the area of the playground. (Use π = 22/7)

(CHSL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 4136 × 102 cm2.

Area covered in one round = 2πrh 
Area of play ground = 235 × 2 × \(\frac{22}{7}\) × 14 × 20 
= 413600 cm² = 4136 × 10² cm²
question_hi:
एक रोलर की त्रिज्या 14 सेमी और लंबाई 20 सेमी है। एक खेल के मैदान को समतल करने के लिए इसे एक बार पूरे 235 चक्कर लगाने पड़ते हैं। खेल के मैदान का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 22/7 का प्रयोग कीजिए)
(CHSL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 4136 × 102 सेमी² है। 

एक चक्‍कर में तय किया गया क्षेत्र = 2πrh 
खेल के मैदान का क्षेत्रफल = 235 × 2 × \(\frac{22}{7} \)× 14 × 20 
= 413600 सेमी² = 4136 × 10² सेमी²

question:
If a map of a city were drawn on a scale of 0.2 cm to a km, what area would represent a country if it has an area of 22500 km2?

(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 900 km2.

1 km represents → 0.2 
(1km)² represents → (0.2)2 
22500 km² represents → 22500 × 0.04 = 900 km²
question_hi:
यदि एक शहर के नक्शे में एक किमी. के माप का एक पैमाने पर 0.2 सेमी. से दर्शाया गया है और यदि उस देश का क्षेत्रफल 22500 किमी2 है, तो उस क्षेत्रफल को निम्न विकल्पों में कैसे दर्शाया जाएगा? 
(CHSL 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 900 किमी² है। 

1 किमी दर्शाता है → 0.2 
(1 किमी)² दर्शाता है → (0.2)2 
22500 किमी² दर्शाता है → 22500 × 0.04 = 900 किमी²
